top_categories.workout_context: 56ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Prairie Burn 100's Iowa rolling, Local event forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
At Prairie Burn 100, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Prairie Burn 100. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Prairie Burn 100's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
62 miles on Iowa rolling gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on Iowa rolling gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
When someone attacks on Iowa rolling gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Prairie Burn 100, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for Prairie Burn 100. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work for 3,500ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Prairie Burn 100’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Prairie Burn 100 requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on iowa rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: iowa rolling, local event, midwest gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 62 miles of iowa rolling gravel in Grinnell, Iowa.
